title: A LOGIC FOR DEFAULT DEONTIC REASONING
reasoning: The paper develops a formal proof-theoretic framework for deontic logic, which is the study of normative and ethical reasoning. It specifically applies this logic to religious normative systems (Talmudic and Rabbinic examples such as Example 4.11 and 4.13) and classical ethical dilemmas (Euthyphro's dilemma, Forrester's paradox).
